title: Signal: conda environment dependency declared without a version
scope: A environment.yml file that declares an environment dependency with no version constraint and no build string.
limitations: It matches an environment dependency with no version constraint and no build string in the parsed environment.yml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A environment.yml that mentions an environment dependency with no version constraint and no build string in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
